title: Services
meta_description: What we offer and what it costs.
sections: Simple, honest pricing — no surprise fees. Ask about a season-long package and save.

ServiceWhat's IncludedStarting At
Weekly MowingMow, edge, and blow — every week, rain or shine$45/visit
Garden DesignNew flower beds, mulching, and planting$350
Seasonal CleanupLeaf removal, gutter clearing, bed tidy-up$120

Do I have to sign anything?
No. It is month to month, and if you want to stop you tell us and we stop. Nobody has ever had to argue their way out of it.
What happens over winter?
The grass stops needing us around late October. Whole-garden customers keep the leaves, pruning and tidying through winter; lawn-only customers pause and we come back in April without you having to ring.
Will it be the same people each time?
Yes. There are six of us and you will get to know whoever has your street. It is the part customers mention most.
